page.heading: Contract Lines
page.caption: Line items within a supplier contract

empty.title: No contract lines yet
empty.message: Add a line to specify the goods or services covered by this contract.

form.descriptionInfo: Short description of what the line covers.
form.productInfo: Optional catalog product. Leave blank for bespoke lines.
form.lineTypeInfo: Whether the line covers goods, a service, or an expense.
form.kindInfo: Discriminator that drives payroll calculator routing for employment contracts.
form.treatmentInfo: How the line is accounted and billed: recurring, one-time, usage-based, or minimum commitment.
form.quantityInfo: Number of units. Use 1 for flat-fee lines.
form.unitPriceInfo: Price per unit in the contract currency.
form.totalAmountInfo: Total for this line. Auto-calculated as quantity × unit price.
form.startDateInfo: When this line becomes effective. Defaults to the contract start.
form.endDatePlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit contract end
form.endDateInfo: When this line expires. Defaults to the contract end.
form.expenditureCategoryInfo: Overrides the contract-level category for this line.
form.expenseAccountInfo: GL account override for this line.
form.locationInfo: Receiving location for this line, if different from the contract location.

confirm.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this line? This action cannot be undone.

validation.quantity_invalid: Quantity must be greater than zero
validation.unit_price_invalid: Unit price must be zero or greater
validation.total_amount_invalid: Total amount must be zero or greater
validation.end_before_start: End date must be on or after start date
validation.kind_incompatible_with_contract: Line kind is not compatible with the parent contract kind
